text.en:
Plaza Calderon de la Barca and the San Fernando bridge, both located in Binondo, Manila, are
hereby renamed Plaza Lorenzo Ruiz and Lorenzo Ruiz Bridge, respectively, in honor of Lorenzo Ruiz, the
Filipino proto-martyr.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: September 12, 1981
